meta.name: Generative Edit (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, 40 steps)
meta.promptFormat: Change this image so that it shows {prompt}, keeping everything else exactly as it is.
meta.promptFormatImperative: {prompt}. Keep everything else exactly as it is.
meta.notes: ComfyUI's official 'Image Edit (Qwen-Image 2511)' template (2026-10) exactly: UNETLoader → ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.1 → CFGNorm 1.0 → KSampler euler/simple, denoise 1, 40 steps at CFG 4; FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod index_timestep_zero on both conditionings; FluxKontextImageScale for the reference; the picture itself VAE-encoded as the latent. No noise mask: the instruction decides what changes, and the engine masks the result layer to the selection when there is one. Reference images (the Generate panel's deck, `references` on generate.edit) bind `image2` and `image3` of both encoders straight from LoadImage, as the official graph wires them (the encoder scales them itself); the prompt calls them image 2 and image 3. A reference not given is pruned with its node (meta.references).
meta.creator: Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Changes the picture by instruction with 40 steps; up to two reference images
